title: Area Highlight Filter

div.h1: Highlight a part of every area
div.p: Pick a traffic source. Each section's visits stay on the chart, faded with an outline, and the visits that source brought are drawn solid in front from the same baseline. In the stacked chart below, the source's visits form their own stack.
